title: More Anvils+
description: Adds Diamond, Amethyst, and Bedrock Anvils with custom models, unique GUI themes, special durability, villager trades, and a powerful Bedrock Hammer.
body:
# More Anvils

**More Anvils** is a Vanilla+ anvil expansion mod that adds new custom anvils, unique GUI themes, special durability behavior, villager trades, crafting recipes, and a late-game Bedrock Anvil system.

The mod is designed for survival players, builders, RPG-style modpacks, enchanting rooms, and anyone who wants more stylish and useful anvil options in Minecraft.

## Features

* **Diamond Anvil** – a high-tier anvil with a custom diamond-themed model, cyan GUI, falling behavior, and better durability than a normal anvil.
* **Amethyst Anvil** – a magical crystal-style anvil with a purple model and matching GUI, perfect for enchanting rooms, fantasy builds, and decorative bases.
* **Bedrock Anvil** – a powerful late-game anvil with a dark bedrock-themed GUI, explosion resistance, special breaking rules, and experimental reduced XP cost behavior.
* **Bedrock Hammer** – a custom 3D special tool used to break and recover the Bedrock Anvil. It is fire-resistant and designed as a late-game utility item.
* **Custom GUI themes** – each special anvil has its own themed anvil screen instead of using the normal vanilla GUI.
* **Crafting recipes** – Diamond and Amethyst Anvils can be crafted with their matching materials.
* **Villager trades** – Bedrock Anvil and Bedrock Hammer can be obtained through special late-game villager trades.
* **Falling anvil behavior** – custom anvils keep the classic falling anvil feel.
* **Survival-friendly progression** – stronger anvils and special mechanics are balanced around late-game survival.

## Experimental Notice

The Bedrock Anvil reduced XP cost system is currently experimental. It works in many cases, but some repair or enchantment combinations may not reduce the cost perfectly yet. This feature may be improved in future updates.

## Planned Future Updates

* More anvil types
* More GUI themes
* Netherite Anvil
* Emerald Anvil
* Gold Anvil
* Copper Anvil
* More special tools
* Improved Bedrock Anvil XP system
* More villager trades and crafting recipes
* New special anvil mechanics

## Supported Version

* Minecraft **1.20.1** – Forge

More Anvils adds more themes, more progression, and more special mechanics while keeping a simple Vanilla+ feel.
